the same note records HybridAHS/NeuralKalmanAHS journal results on 200 utterances at loop gains 2, 2.5 and 3: NeuralKalmanAHS SDR 2.65, 1.98 and 1.45 dB and PESQ 2.33, 2.17 and 2.04, with HybridAHS v2 complex-ratio-mask results reported as the strongest overall trade-off in parts of the study.

the same note records that the public YIXUANZ/NeuralKalmanAHS and YIXUANZ/AHS_2023 repositories expose README/demo HTML, CSS and audio files, with no source implementation or model checkpoints in their visible file listings and no release assets for NeuralKalmanAHS.
